This is tournament play, mostly best of three, not the Arena ladder. 1 of 5797 lists left out for cards Standard does not allow: Akroma's Vengeance (1), Aura of Silence (1), Barren Moor (1), Caves of Koilos (1), Decree of Justice (1).
